text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, Trainery-poo. Do you know what 
this is?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
'A cafe where information on Uma Musume 
gathers.' We got another tip on Umatter~.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"Word is it's a hidden gem of a shop. The 
tip only included landmarks on how to get 
there, though."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Plus, that landmark is written in some 
kind of code, y'know~
choice_data_list: Huh, is that so.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I feigned ignorance and listened along... 
Though the truth was, I was the one who 
sent that info.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Thanks to her, our outing the other day 
was so exciting. That's why I want to 
return the favor."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
So I searched for an outing destination 
that might pique Transcend's interest, but 
will it work...?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Personally, I'm pretty tempted... Whaddya 
think, Train-chan?
choice_data_list: …! Ah, that looks interesting!
…! Yeah, that looks interesting!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Alrighty, it's settled~. Let's get going, 
get going.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"'The beckoning cat watching over the 
shopping district'... It should be around 
here, shouldn't it?"
choice_data_list: Ah, that watch shop's display window...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Found it, the cat figurine! First landmark 
spotted~

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Nice assist, Trai-chan. Way to go~
choice_data_list: Ayyy~

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
The next clue is "a mirror showing a 
distorted smile," huh. Hmm, hmm... 
distorted, mirror...
choice_data_list:
Maybe it's a mirror that distorts the 
scenery.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Does that mean like a convex mirror? 
Speaking of convex mirrors on the road...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
A convex traffic mirror! There it is, that 
one!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Man, this really gets you hyped, doesn't 
it? Searching for landmarks like this 
feels just like a treasure hunt, right?
choice_data_list: (Great! She's having fun...!)

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
So this is the final stop... The 'café 
where Umamusume intel gathers', huh.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Well now. I wonder how much truth there is 
to that rumor.
choice_data_list: Shall we go inside for now?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: ...Hm. Well, I suppose so.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The two of us sat down at a corner table. 
After quickly placing our order, we 
discreetly looked around the shop, and...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Ohh...! What a massive collection of Paka 
Petit. They even have autographs from 
famous Umamusume on display.
choice_data_list:
Looks like the master here is a racing 
fan.

Looks like the master here is a racing 
fan.

text_block_list.name: Master
text_block_list.text:
So, how about the upcoming race? Who do 
you think is going to win?

text_block_list.name: Regular Customer A
text_block_list.text:
Number 3 is totally gonna win! Nobody can 
catch up to a front-runner like that!

text_block_list.name: Regular Customer B
text_block_list.text:
That runner struggles on courses with 
slopes, right? More importantly, look at 
No. 12—her track record isn't flashy, but 
isn't she building a solid foundation?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
...I see~. A cafe where like-minded 
enthusiasts gather, huh?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
It's true, fan predictions are a valuable 
source of information. Sometimes outsiders 
can see things we miss.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Man, you found me. What a nice little 
hideaway♪

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Quite a haul, quite a haul âª Super 
satisfying~ Gotta thank our informant.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing Transcend's pleased expression 
makes me want to confess that I was the 
one who tipped her off. But...
choice_data_list:
(It wouldn't be very classy to say that, 
though.)

(It wouldn't be very classy to say that, 
would it.)

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Trai-chan, Trai-chan. Thanks a bunch for 
today.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: —Thanks for recommending that shop to me.
choice_data_list: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Aha. Hit the nail right on the head, huh.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
You're the one who sent that cryptic 
tip-off, aren't you, Trainee?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, Trainer-chan was 
dropping just the right hints today so I 
could reach the shop, weren't ya?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"Even when you ordered, you were so brisk 
and seemed so used to it. I was totally 
thinking, 'She's definitely been here 
before~.'"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
So basically, you planned out everything 
today just for my sake, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Throwing in a riddle-solving element? 
Well, aren't you a clever one~ Oh, you!
choice_data_list: I'm glad I could make you happy
I'm so glad you're happy with it!

If I get any good scoops, I'll share them 
with you again.

If I get any good scoops, I'll let you 
know.
Well now, whatever could you mean?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Throwing in a riddle-solving element? 
Well, aren't you a clever one~ Oh, you!
choice_data_list: I'm glad I could make you happy
I'm so glad you're happy with it!

If I get any good scoops, I'll share them 
with you again.

If I get any good scoops, I'll let you 
know.
Well now, whatever could you mean?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe. I am thoroughly satisfied, yes 
siree.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"I totally welcome surprises like this. Do 
it again sometime, Trainee♪"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Oh, sounds great!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Counting on you for the next scoop, Boss.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Counting on you for the next scoop, Big 
Sis.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Come on, don't try acting all cool now~.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Come on, after everything you and I have 
been through, Train-chan.
